item.title: Hilton to unveil LXR Hotels and Resorts in former Palazzo Versace site
item.description: Hilton's LXR Hotels and Resorts will make its Australian debut in 2027 following a new signing of the hotel previously known as Palazzo Versace and currently operating as The Imperial Hotel. The post Hilton to unveil LXR Hotels and Resorts in former Palazzo Versace site appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: 1834 Hotels secures two Auckland properties as first foray into New Zealand
item.description: 1834 Hotels has added two new Auckland hotels to its growing management portfolio, initiating the group’s expansion across the Pacific and marking its entry into New Zealand. item.title: New direct Perth and Christchurch flights a boon for New Zealand hoteliers
item.description: Jetstar will launch seasonal direct flights between Perth and Christchurch from October with thrice-weekly services and upwards of 30,000 seats between the two cities. The post New direct Perth and Christchurch flights a boon for New Zealand hoteliers appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: The future of guest experience
item.description: Hospitality is evolving beyond service. Hotels now drive connection, community impact and wellbeing by designing spaces, experiences and operations that enrich guests and the wider visitor economy. The post The future of guest experience appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Redefining Commercial Sleep
item.description: A long-awaited evolution of the Sealy Commercial Hospitality Range, thoughtfully redesigned to meet modern guest expectations, operational demands and the diverse needs of today’s accommodation industry. The post Redefining Commercial Sleep appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.description: Accor lands a new Vice President Operations for New Zealand and Fiji, while an Emporium Hotel South Bank former employee returns in a new leadership role. The post Key appointments: Accor, Emporium Hotel South Bank appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Scale drives record 2025 for Wyndham in Asia Pacific
item.description: Wyndham Hotels and Resorts has capped a breakthrough year with double-digit net room growth, plus hundreds of openings and signings across Asia Pacific. The post Scale drives record 2025 for Wyndham in Asia Pacific appeared first on Hotel Management.
